Mistrovství ČR Trialový Zálesák je tak t: The Czech Trial Zálesák Championship is a bit of a nod to the popular smaller Trial races of a few years ago, ridden under modified Openfree rules, and also a bit of a parody of today's Trial under the Czech Cycling Federation. Despite the rain a few enthusiasts gathered, and in the end 9 riders started in the adult category (compared to the 15 originally registered) plus a small kids' squad. The race took place at a secret forest spot that has been ridden for decades, but always only about once a year in dry conditions. In the wet it's a different league. The rules were adjusted to involve both rider performance and tactics. Simply so you had to think as well :) To everyone's surprise, the Elite 20” was won by Tobík Dolák, ahead of his guru Lukáš Valný and Pepa Neumann. In Elite 26” the win went to Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, ahead of Mára Tryner and Petr Jeřicha. The performance of the day came from Mára, who tried to wipe out Vlasta's lead and ended up taking a bit of a swim in the river, but it was a really interesting battle with crashes, slipping brakes and drama at the end.
Vlasta, Lukáš Valný a hostující Jířa Seh: The day before the race, Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and guest rider Jířa Sehnal did an exhibition near Blansko, where unfortunately the first of them pulled his back. Thanks for the invitation.

Celé dopoledne bylo věnováno základní te: The whole morning was devoted to basic technique, riding over sleepers, body position on the bike, the pump track (i.e. rollers and berms) and the trail in our park. Then we moved to the popular Říčany restaurant Na Jurečku to refuel and rehydrate. And after lunch it was straight out into the terrain for descents, roots and even a hint of dropping.
Musíme všem smeknout klobouk, protože na: We have to take our hats off to everyone, because on the same terrain many men would at least hesitate or get off the bike. They simply went for it with heart and encouragement.  After returning to the park there was a final workshop by Mára Tryner focused on bike repair and maintenance, and a look at the MALOJA 2021 collection.
Děkujeme všem za účast a na dotaz ohledn: Thanks to everyone for taking part – we'll answer questions about the next date within a few days :)
Po roce jsme opět měli příměstský tábor: After a year we once again held a bike day camp. Putting the team together took relatively long, but in the end we assembled a great group of bikers and leaders who prepared an interesting five days on the bike for more than 27 boys and girls. The weather was against us at first, but a proper biker rides in all weathers. Honza Havránek could tell you all about that as a downhiller. Michal Budský as a Trial rider would have a harder time, but he is a versatile rider with experience across several disciplines. The guys also had young guns Tobík and Dan, who helped with everything our capable leaders Lenka and Klárka needed. Vlasta was in charge of preparation, building, Trial training and a few other small things.
Jezdci byli šikovní a nenašel se nikdo k: The riders were skilful and there wasn't a single one who didn't improve. A competition every day, the occasional small crash (luckily nothing serious) and enthusiasm for riding from all the boys and girls.
Děkujeme za zpětné ohlasy od rodičů i dě: Thank you for the feedback from parents and kids – hopefully we'll manage to organise another edition.
Máme pár záběrů z elektrobikefestival.cz: We have some footage from elektrobikefestival.cz, or rather from its partly rained-out Saturday.
Je nám ctí, že se v termínu 3-5.7. budem: We are honoured that from 3 to 5 July we will be looking after young riders at the {1}{2}MTB Trilogy{3}{4} stage race as part of our new project {5}{6}Bikeskills.cz{7}{8}. Více informací naleznete na jejich webu: You'll find more information on their website {1}{2}MTB Trilogy …{3}{4}

Malá vesnička na severu pořádala cyklode: A small village in the north held a cycling day, and our team – Lukáš Valný, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and kids from the club – was invited too. {1}31/5 – Trojexhibice - Celá Česká repu: {1}31/5 – Triple exhibition – all over the Czech Republic{2}

Exhibice obecní slavnosti Dolní Řasnice: Village festival exhibition in Dolní Řasnice
Náročná první exhibice po zranění pro Vl: A demanding first exhibition after injury for Vlasta, and also for the other riders, who had to cope with the extreme heat at the event in picturesque Řasnice. We were a bit surprised by an almost hour-long traffic jam on the way to Liberec, which delayed other performers at the event too.
Na místě už to místní rozjížděli a pan s: The locals were already in full swing when we arrived, and the mayor welcomed us in full gear. On the gravel surface we had a carpet ready to ride on. O tomto víkendu jsme rozjeli poslední ví: This weekend we ran the last Bikeskills weekend camps. Both the women's and men's camps brought together a decent group of riders who wanted to improve and progress – each within their own abilities, of course.
Po dopoledních základech, pumptracku, kl: After the morning basics, pump track, berms and – for the men – jumps, we moved to the nearby Marvánek swimming pool for lunch and then along our traditional route, where we have various technical spots ready, from drops and Trial to descents for riders of all levels.
Díky moc všem účastníkům za snahu, trpěl: Many thanks to all participants for their effort, their patience with our explanations and the appreciation at the end. Hopefully Vlasta, Katarína and Matouš passed something on to you.
Tradiční akce, kterou pořádá klub MTB &: The traditional event organised by the MTB & Trial Mraveniště Říčany club under the leadership of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček has grown somewhat since Pavel Hájek (former manager of the FORBIKES trade fair) joined.
Tradiční akce, kterou pořádá klub MTB &a: The traditional event organised by the MTB & Trial Mraveniště Říčany club under the leadership of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček has grown somewhat since Pavel Hájek (former manager of the FORBIKES trade fair) joined. This year the programme was expanded, the event returned to a two-day format (as in the days of hosting international UCI C1 races) and an Expo zone was added.
Plány veliké, příprava náročná, ale osud: Big plans, demanding preparation – but the fate of outdoor events is always the roulette called weather. Šlapačky really got a taste of it this year. On the Monday before the race a storm arrived that completely destroyed the Tehov pump track. Thanks to the municipality of Tehov and Michal Maroši, a group of people was found who restored it almost to its original state, which – had it lasted – would have guaranteed a beautifully groomed track. Unfortunately, on Friday evening and practically all of Saturday all hell broke loose in Říčany and Tehov. The rain only stopped late on Saturday afternoon. The pump track was again practically half destroyed. But every event organiser knows you have to fight for success. So repairs to the pump track went on late into the night, with the promised warmer, sunny Sunday in prospect. Fortunately, it came.
Prakticky většinu disciplín ze soboty se: Practically most of Saturday's disciplines were moved to Sunday in a limited form. First to start was the rescheduled kids' Trial race, where spectators could admire the art of overcoming obstacles performed by the youngest kids from the club and guests. The race was ridden under modified rules that motivate riders to complete the whole section more than the current official rules do.
Kvůli harmonogramu se jel závod rychle a: Because of the schedule the race was run quickly, and some riders could jump straight into the kids' MTB XC races, which were very physically demanding as the terrain slowly dried out. Parents cheered and the kids didn't give away a centimetre. The difficulty was reflected in the number of riders who gave up in the high humidity and heat – but hats off to them for finding the courage to race in these conditions.
Následoval exhibiční závod Trialu dospěl: Next came the adults' Trial exhibition race, which was something of a Trial celebration. Four generations of Trial riders faced each other in one race. Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion, against his master, multiple world champion Martin Šimůnek, who after almost 10 years of riding exhibitions tried racing again. As if that weren't enough, local native, Czech champion and Vlasta's student Petr Jeřicha also returned after 5 years. The circle was completed by Matouš Balík, Lukáš Valný and other guys from the club. Victory across all course difficulties went to Petr Jeřicha ahead of Martin and Vlasta. The latter took the win in the Elite category and the Trial record. The bunny hop contest was won by Lukáš Valný.
Už v průběhu Trialu dospělých se začalo: While the adults' Trial was still going, training started on the pump track, which had dried a little. Pump track training had to be banned all morning. Conditions were the same for all riders, and although the track was slow and physically demanding, there were lots of great performances in the battles for fat prize money, trophies and medals.
Na akci v letošním roce startovalo přes: This year more than 115 riders started at the event, lots of fans came, and even more were unfortunately put off by the weather. You'll be able to watch footage from the event on ČT Déčko, or on the Trialshow and Bikeskills team YouTube channels once the edit is finished.
Těšíme se s vámi na příští ročník a snad: We look forward to seeing you at next year's edition – hopefully the weather order will work out this time..
Chlapi na campu si užili déšť i sluníčko: The men at camp enjoyed both rain and sunshine
První letošní camp pro chlapy byl hodně: This year's first camp for men was very much about May drizzle. The forecast was completely off – when it was supposed to be sunny it rained, and vice versa. Anyway, it wasn't a downpour, and a classic windbreaker kept everyone alive and at a reasonable operating temperature.
Protože se jednalo o camp se střední obt: As it was an intermediate camp, it was clear we'd tackle harder things. After the morning classics in the Tehov park we went straight to the descents in the former quarry, where a few tricky muddy, rocky lines run. In the end everyone found their limit, and more than one die-hard who couldn't resist temptation ended up on their side on the slope. Fortunately there were no serious injuries or trips to hospital, and in the end everyone outdid themselves and hopefully took away something useful from the camp for the trails and the future..
Teď jen opakovat, trénovat a zkoušet :): Now just repeat, train and try :) Hopefully see you again at a men's camp during/after the summer holidays.
Tradiční exhibiční termín je Evropský de: A traditional exhibition date is European Car-Free Day, when our team is fully booked. This year the fastest to book were the organisers in Štětí and in Prague. Lukáš Valný, Marek Tryner and, somewhat unplanned, Matouš Balík rode together at Náměstí Republiky in Prague, enjoying a beautiful sunny day.
Vlasta s Martinem Šimůnkem měli pro změn: Vlasta and Martin Šimůnek, on the other hand, had slightly gloomy weather, but still pleasant riding on the square in Štětí, where kids from local schools came along.
Obě akce byly současně i workshopem, kde: Both events were also workshops where kids could borrow Trial and regular MTB bikes to try out.
Ples spolku obcí v Čepřovicích: Ball of the association of municipalities in Čepřovice
Dorazila nám pozvánka z Čepřovic nedalek: We received an invitation from Čepřovice near Strakonice, where a ball of 6 municipalities was being held. Nothing was left to chance – the organiser booked us back in January, so we were free and the team of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Lukáš Valný could head to the event. Besides the mayor, we also had kids on hand, who gave us great support. The atmosphere was lively, as is usual at village balls, and from among the sportsmen and sportswomen we chose a few volunteers who weren't afraid to lie down under our bikes. Thanks for the invitation – hopefully see you at an exhibition or workshop next year.
Omlouvám se za zhoršenou kvalitu fotek -: Sorry for the lower photo quality – we only managed to get a video, from which they were created.
Rozloučení s Tehovským parkem před zimou: Our farewell to the Tehov park before winter – and hopefully its spring rebuild – in the form of small races and training was moved a bit. There was a risk that few riders would come because of the long weekend, but in the end the turnout was a surprise. About 20 riders started in Trial and a similar number on the pump track, which is about half of the club's members. The weather was for tougher characters – alternately muddy, but without rain – but the kids didn't mind and the adult riders survived too 🙂
Pravidla byla jako každý rok na základě: As every year, the rules were based on OPEN FREE, with riders choosing the arrows they want to ride and the difficulty. Categories were divided by age and, for older riders, by riders. Each rider had to adapt the course to themselves with a limit of 5–6 arrows per section. Riding was in groups, each with its own judge, who could also adjust the rules to suit the riders.
Bylo skvělé, že dorazilo i pár klubových: It was great that a few club legends who don't normally come to training showed up too. Michal Havránek got up from his director's chair, saddled his blue Ozonys and battled more with his physical fitness – which, as he said, he needs to catch up on – than with the bike. Martin Šimůnek rode his last big event on a 24” before switching to 26”, on which he won a number of world titles, and he really surprised in his duel with Míra Brunclík. Honestly, doing gaps onto around 10–11 pallets in the mud after turning 50 is insane, and on one of the sections in the first round Míra and Martin even managed to beat Mára and Vlasta. At the other end of the age spectrum, a Martin also cleverly took 3rd place – but this one from the Gomboš family.
Pravidla byla hodně o hlavě a přemýšlení: The rules were very much about using your head and thinking, so even a rider weaker in jumping or performance could beat a more experienced one if they attempted harder arrows – and the results showed it. 5 riders entered on 20” bikes and the same number on 26”. Tobík Dolák won Elite 20” just ahead of his 20-inch guru Valňák, and Vlasta battled Mára Tryner for first place on the 26-inch bikes.
Pumptrack se jel hned v zápětí, aby měli: The pump track followed straight after, so the Trial riders had time to change clothes and bikes. After a few practice runs, the youngest riders on balance bikes started, and then it went all the way up to the fastest adults.
The finale was all about tidying up and sausages.

They chose our team, for which we thank them. The bit of time pressure didn't throw us, we fitted into the space and didn't destroy any of the expensive lasers and LED screens. This time we didn't use our traditional obstacles but stylishly rode on classic pallets, and Vlasta even put on a BigMat T-shirt. He was backed up by Marek Tryner in his first exhibition after his knee injury, Tobík Dolák, who ended up as a volunteer, and Lukáš Valný, who for the first time in his life experienced a technical problem during an exhibition, when his chain snapped after maybe the first 3 jumps on a brand-new bike. Not a great advert for that X9 range.
Děkujeme za pozvání, luxusní fotky i vid: Thanks for the invitation and the luxurious photos and video.

During the camps there was already talk of buying new bikes, changing pedals and buying protectors. Thanks also to everyone for the positive feedback on the spot – we'll look forward to any further camps or individual coaching.
Pár fotek níže od Kataríny a zbytek včet: A few photos from Katarína below; the rest, including videos, we're sending directly to the participants.

Our exhibition and workshop were in the centre of the sports zones in the local chateau park, right opposite the mobile stage. Unfortunately, as soon as we arrived it was clear that Vlasta, Martin and Matouš were in for a tough time. Rain, rain and a temperature you wouldn't send a dog out in. There was nothing to do but set everything up and wait until the afternoon to see if spectators would come.
Diváci přišli - déšť zůstal. Kluci i úča: The spectators came – and so did the rain. The guys and participants fought bravely, and even in total rain the workshop ran at full speed. We had to change the exhibition plan, and the first show took place on the stage, where Martin Šimůnek dared to jump even on the wet, slippery surface.
Asi hodinu na to vykouklo na malou chvil: About an hour later the sun peeked out for a moment, and Vlasta and Matouš got their bikes out to jump for the local TV crew. Vlasta then did a small demonstration on the stage and the jumps over the tape, finishing a little above 125 cm, which isn't bad at all given the conditions. Matouš warmed up on the obstacles, with the only condition being that he couldn't jump down to the ground, which was one big mud bath. We simply did our best, the organiser thanked us and so did the spectators for our courage. Thanks for the invitation – and next year without rain.

Nálož 4 exhibic napříč republikou: A load of 4 exhibitions across the country
Cestovní maraton exhibic začal ve středu: Our travelling marathon of exhibitions started on Wednesday at the sports games for athletes with disabilities, right away with full firepower of 4 Trial bike riders (Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Matouš Balík, Lukáš Pařízek and Tobík Nenadál as the youngest of the group) plus Dalibor Šulc as a moto-trial rider. It was great to bring them a little joy and experiences, of which they had plenty at this event thanks to a great organising team.
Jedna z prvních letošních firemních akcí: One of this year's first corporate events, at the open days of Statech (forklifts and aerial work platforms), was led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Martin Šimůnek. On Friday Matouš Balík and Vlasta set off towards Holešov, where the traditional felling of the maypole was taking place in the picturesque village of Rymice. It came down just as they arrived, so the guys saw it hit the road in front of their car. The exhibition then took place by the stage at the local municipal office. The local crowd, young and old, enjoyed the event and cheered like crazy throughout our exhibition. We also battled the slippery surface of the outdoor dance floor in front of the stage, and there were some impressive performances over the final tape from both Matouš and Vlasta.
V Zubří byl náš tým už v roce 2017 a mís: Our team was already in Zubří back in 2017, and the locals chose us again to celebrate the 10th anniversary of this local event. The beautiful athletics grounds of the local school were complemented by sunny, hot weather and a huge turnout of spectators, who even had a grandstand for more comfortable viewing of the rich programme prepared by the organisers. After almost 4 hours of driving, Lukáš Valný and Vlasta took care of the event, riding a 30-minute exhibition including competitions for kids and jumping over the tape. Thanks to everyone for your support, and congratulations to the young athletes on taking part and on their placings.

Martin Šimůnek continued on a solo ride in Králův Dvůr, where he let himself be egged on into jumping off a shipping container converted into toilets :)
Sice to ráno vypadalo na propršený den,: In the morning it looked like a rainy day, but in the end the weather was 100% perfect – which can't be said of the following few days.
Když sjezd vyhraje Trialista: When a Trial rider wins the downhill
Report Vlasty Kabeláče Čiháčka z exhibic: Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's report from the exhibition in Rakovník, where he, Lukáš Valný and Martin Šimůnek fell victim to a downhillers' conspiracy 🙂
{1}\"Rakovnické cyklování je jednou z ve: {1}"Rakovnické cyklování is one of the big cycling events, normally allowing riders to start in 7 disciplines – from XC to the Downtown urban downhill. Unfortunately the coronavirus affected events like this too, so the organiser had to keep participant numbers down. Anyway, the event went ahead, and a day full of action awaited me, Martin Šimůnek and Lukáš Valný. {2}
{1}Původně jsme jeli jen na 3 exhibiční: {1}Originally we only went for 3 exhibition shows, and in the gap between the 2nd and 3rd we planned to test the local trails. It all ended differently – after we tried the footbridge over the local lake, where a crossing race was to take place the next day, the organisers of the downhill part offered us a ride in the exhibition downhill race instead of the trails. None of us had ever ridden downhill, and since the course was short and had no jumps, we said why not. The organisers even moved the start for us so we could make our last exhibition show.{2}
{1}Trénink byl super a utažené zatáčky n: {1}Practice was great, and the tight corners probably gave us a bit of an advantage, because anyone who could get through on the front wheel gained a lot. It was practically a pure technique downhill. Based on practice I personally thought Lukáš Valný would be on the podium, but what do I know. Martin Šimůnek's 10-year-old Remedy is a bit worn out, and he was a bit out of place on 26”, but…. A race is a race and Martin has it in his blood. Without a front brake he still took 8th place out of 15 riders. Lukáš Valný was second after the first run but finished 4th in the end. At the awards ceremony we had long since changed and were practising back on our Trial bikes (it takes a moment to get used to them again), so we found it strange that they were calling us to the podium. The announcement of the downhill winner was a bit of a shock for everyone, including me. I was the only one who somehow got under 20 seconds, and with a relaxed ride I won. At first I thought they were joking (it would be just like the guys), but after checking the results I went up on the podium for the diploma. So among my dreams come true, besides Trial titles, I can now tick off a win in a DH race :D Here's to chance and Trial skills.{2}"
20-21/5 - Exhibice Pražské služby, Strup: 20–21/5 – Exhibitions for Pražské služby, Strupčice and ON Semiconductor
Víkend 20 a 21.5. jsme opět trávili na k: We spent the weekend of 20–21 May on the bike again, but this time in nice weather that accompanied us on our long journeys. On Saturday the traditional Pražské služby event took place in Malešice, where Vlasta and Michal Budský rode together with parkour athletes and freestyle guys. {1}Rekord na rozhlednu a dvě exhibice tý: {1}A lookout tower record and two team exhibitions – Miskovice and Hořepník{2}{3}{4}Sometimes ideas come up that turn out to be very much on the edge. One of them was the idea from Miskovice and Aleš Matoušek to try riding up the local 199-step lookout tower on a bike. The choice fell on Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, holder of the record for riding up and down the Petřín lookout tower.
Protože se jednalo o exhibiční show, nej: As it was an exhibition show, there was first a roughly 30-minute demonstration with egging on from Lukáš Valný and Tobík Dolák. Vlasta then took a few minutes' rest and set off to conquer the tower. Without any practice. The crisis came right after the first floor and only deepened. The steps were small for the larger diameter of mountain bike wheels, and the metal itself didn't help with grip either. In the end it took a third more hops than there were steps. From the second floor on: cramps and braking with two fingers. But the goal wasn't just to get to the top – which he did in 4:05 min – but also to get back down, and that's where the biggest problem arose. The Cube e-bike available was great, but the steps were small and had no barriers at the railings to prevent falls. Twice it already looked like a trip over the handlebars, arrow pointing down, because of the cramps in his hands, but luckily after two dabs Vlasta found his rhythm and rode down the floors partly on the front wheel, so he fitted safely. Down in 2:51 min, and an overall time of 6:56.74 min is beyond expectations given the preparation and conditions.{1} “After this I needed the whole day to pull myself together. I don't think I've ever been in worse physical shape after any sporting performance in my career, and physically it can't be compared with classic Trial. There, luckily, I do everything within 2 minutes and that's it. Thanks to the guys from the team, Aleš and my family for their help and support.”{2} said Vlasta, commenting on setting the record

Před pár týdny se nám do týmu Bikeskills: A few weeks ago our Bikeskills.cz team literally got its hands on SPANK handlebars with the so-called {1}VIBROCORE™ {2}core. For us it was a big unknown – we didn't know what to expect from the bars and, honestly, didn't have high expectations, because they're simply 'just' handlebars. But after the test everything changed, and now I'm thinking…. WHY NOT? I'll explain everything below.
Princip je na první pohled jednoduchý. J: The principle is simple at first glance. It's a foam of a specific density injected into the cavity of the handlebar, filling about 80% of it. Why not all of it? The ends of the bar are foam-free and ready for possible cutting, so you don't immediately cut into the Vibrocore{1}™{2}{3} {4}foam.
Co je ale zajímavější, tak pěna má poměr: What's more interesting is that the foam has a fairly high density and is also biodegradable. The filling also increases the overall strength of the bar, which is a nice benefit, but certainly not the main goal SPANK set itself. Only when we talk about vibrations does the key word Vibrocore{1}™{2}{3} come into play.{4}
Jako první každého napadne pohlcení vibr: The first thing that comes to mind is absorbing vibrations while riding. Partly yes and partly no. The purpose of the Vibroco{1}re{2}{3}™{4} filling is not primarily to absorb vibrations (that's more what suspension forks, shocks etc. on your bike are for), but rather to change the vibration frequency. Absorbing vibrations is a small part of it, but not the main purpose of foam-filled handlebars.
Vibrocore™{1} {2}byl vytířben po několik: Vibrocore™{1} {2}was developed over several years into a precisely defined type of foam that changes the frequency of vibrations transmitted from the wheels into the handlebars during riding, and from the handlebars on to the rider's hands and forearms.
Zajímavé video, které popisuje vývoj {1}: You can find an interesting video describing the development of {1}Vibrocore{2}{3}™{4} here:
Frekvence během jízdy na MTB kole dosahu: The frequency while riding an MTB is somewhere between 2 and 200 Hz, which is a fairly wide range. It depends on riding style and the surface you're riding on. However, most common vibrations are somewhere between 5 and 50 Hz. Every handlebar, whether carbon or aluminium, also has its own vibration frequency, so it not only nicely transmits vibrations from the wheels, frame, fork etc., but also produces its own vibration – which, simply put, creates….an amazing storm of vibrations.
Podle SPANK stránek, kde se popisuje pod: According to the SPANK website, which describes the whole {1}Vibrocore{2}{3}™{4} system in more detail (see: https://spank-ind.com/blogs/news/vibrocore™-the-inside-story), it has been shown that vibrations with a frequency of about 8–50 Hz are dangerous for the hands, hand muscles and forearms and can cause so-called HAVS, which can gradually progress to so-called CECS. I'm not an expert or a doctor, but after a few moments on Google I saw some nasty pictures, and neither idea appeals to me at all.
{1}HAVS (Hand {2}{3}Arm{4}{5} {6}{7}Vibr: {1}HAVS (Hand {2}{3}Arm{4}{5} {6}{7}Vibration{8}{9} Syndrome){10} is also known as {11}white finger syndrome{12}, or {13}Raynaud's{14}{15} syndrome{16}, see: {17}https://www.fyzioklinika.cz/clanky-o-zdravi/raynauduv-syndrom{18}, which often accompanies Raynaud's disease, see: {19}https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raynaudova_nemoc{20}. White to blue fingertips, poor blood circulation and tissue damage, lack of oxygen up to tissue death. Simply nothing pleasant. This
syndrom se často projevuje u povolání, k: syndrome often appears in professions where you work with tools that cause stronger vibrations, such as saws, drills, demolition hammers and so on. However, when riding a bike, especially an MTB on forest paths, roots and bumpy tracks, you simply can't avoid vibrations either, and everyone holds the bars firmly enough so they don't fly out of their hands.
{1}CECS ({2}{3}Chronic{4}{5} {6}{7}Exert: {1}CECS ({2}{3}Chronic{4}{5} {6}{7}Exertional{8}{9} {10}{11}Compartment{12}{13} Syndrome){14}{15} {16}which can be a consequence of HAVS and often appears in motorsport, where a firm grip combined with vibrations from the machine is needed. However, it also appears in bodybuilders and, simply, people who pump iron. Loss of strength in the hands and forearm pain are essentially the result, quite often followed by surgery. Look up photos of CECS – it won't be a pretty sight.
Pěna uvnitř řídítek tedy primárně nepohl: So the foam inside the handlebar doesn't primarily absorb impacts or vibrations. That's simply not what it's there for – it changes the vibration frequency of the bar and wheel away from the dangerous frequencies mentioned, which can (though of course for some people never will) cause damage to the muscles and nerves of the hands or loss of control of the bike and so on.
CO JSME SI Z&nbsp;TESTU ODNESLI: WHAT WE TOOK AWAY FROM THE TEST
Řidítka SPANK patří mezi jedny z&nbsp;ne: SPANK handlebars are among the best on the market even without {1}Vibrocore{2}{3}™{4}{5} {6}foam, which has now reached its 6th generation. The SPANK SPIKE 35 handlebar we tested fits perfectly in the hand, and its oversize 35 mm diameter suggests increased overall stiffness for Enduro or DH.
Nyní se ale vrátím k&nbsp;úvodní myšlenc: Now let me go back to the opening thought. When someone has devoted so much attention to something like vibrations, vibration frequency and preventing conditions like HAVS and CECS, why not take the chance to give your hands a 'longer lifespan' without pain and problems? You can believe in {1}Vibrocore™ {2}or not, but even if the bars and their internal foam helped prevent problems by just 10% – problems that may not show up on the first ride but, for example, after a long time or in old age…..then…..WHY NOT?{3}

Vlasta reportuje o budování Trailu v Říč: Vlasta reports on building the trail in Říčany:
{1}Jak jsem psal dříve byl jsem osloven: {1}As I wrote earlier, I was approached to build the Olivova trail in my home town of Říčany. There was a very limited budget, and therefore a challenge to do something for the community. I'm an organiser and I have no problem building a natural trail, but a flow trail with jumps is outside my field. After selecting possible builders we went for Kuba Vencl, who used to ride there with local Honza Tóth, and who even got a machine operator's licence for the project. Everything important was sorted, and construction started a few weeks ago. The weather sometimes threw a spanner in the works, but the guys worked fast and the few problems along the way were solved quickly. Today is probably the last day of construction, finishing the surface. I'm attaching a few photos that I think will please every biker's eye. Our club should take over management of the area, and the Bikeskills project will have another place to train on the Tehov – Říčany route.{2}
{1}Na příští rok chystám dvě akce a jedn: {1}For next year I'm preparing two events, one of which will be the season opener and the official opening of the trail, which won't happen this year anymore. It will include a workshop, a dirt jump exhibition and a Trial exhibition.{2}

Dny Javornicka, Lesnický den, Solfest, S: Javornicko Days, Forestry Day, Solfest, Sokolov, Prague 15, a Trial course and a natural disaster
Tak tento týden byl jeden z nejnáročnějš: This week was one of the most demanding I can imagine as a rider and organiser. Thursday started with a morning Trial course for guys who want to fulfil their biker dream and peek behind the scenes of Trial. In the afternoon we headed to Prague 15, where a kids' pump track was being opened with the city leadership in attendance, and my son Márty and I rode a father-and-son exhibition there. On Saturday our team split into 3: Michal Budský and Tobík Dolák rode Forestry Day in Ralsko, Martin Šimůnek and Dominik Budský did an exhibition and workshop in Sokolov, and Lukáš Valný and I went to Javornicko Days, where we rode just before Imagine Diamonds. We finished riding and practically right after us it started raining. Unfortunately, when we got home we found out that a windstorm had swept through the Říčany area and Tehov and flooded our houses/gardens. The parks we manage were hit too, so what followed was dealing with our caretaker duties. On Sunday Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta and Lukáš Valný headed to Solnice for the local Solfest festival, where in incredible heat they rode an exhibition and handed out a few drinks. After returning, more dealing with the aftermath of the windstorm – and that awaits us all next week too.

Before the exhibition itself we visited the Trial park in Hamry nad Sázavou, where we did a light training session that within an hour turned into cold, cloudy, windy weather. We'd given it our all, so there was no point risking injury and we set off for Rohozná.
Tato vesnička o 300-400 obyvatelích se e: This village of 300–400 inhabitants evidently knows how to have fun, and they'd prepared a pretty nice programme with the facilities of the local football club, which was playing its match when we arrived.
Ještě při příjezdu vypadalo počasí dobře: When we arrived the weather still looked good, but unfortunately the tradition of the last 3 weeks repeated itself, and Vlasta and Lukáš Valný with little Marty Kabeláč waited in the car for the rain to stop. After an hour it was clear it wasn't going to pass, and the spectators wanted to be entertained. And since the guys were the highlight of the programme, there was nothing left but to pluck up courage and try to show some Trial art even in the rain. Luckily it all went without a big crash, even though the grass and our obstacles were slippery as ice.

Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček took on the show, and since the event was for nurseries, he also brought his youngest rider Marty Kabeláč (with a proper excuse note for nursery, of course).

Sraz veteránů Horní Police a městské sla: Veteran vehicle meet in Horní Police and town festival in Staré Křečany
Tuto sobotu nás čekal trochu náročnější: This Saturday a slightly more demanding weekend awaited us. Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Matouš Balík headed north for a double exhibition in Horní Police, which was unusually located between the historic and the new bridge. Spectators could watch the action from the tents in front of the stage as well as from the pedestrian zone and the pavements on the bridges. The slightly complicated surface didn't faze the guys, and the exhibitions drew a large crowd.
V pauze mezi ukázkami kluci vyrazili ote: In the break between shows the guys went to test a nearby bike park that could be a venue for Bikeskills.cz coaching courses. Slavnosti Křečanech byli ve velkém stylu: The festival in Křečany was in grand style. Concerts, security, a precisely set schedule. Our job was to fill the slot before one of the main bands. Kulový blesk 2 - Čáslav, Bratronice, Cho: Ball Lightning 2 – Čáslav, Bratronice, Choteč, Suchdol, Bojkovice
Neděle byla doslova jako slavný český fi: Sunday was literally like the famous Czech film Ball Lightning. 3 teams, 5 locations, 6 shows and two stops swapping riders. An incredible onslaught, where one or two mishaps would have made everything collapse like a house of cards.
Ráno nám odpadl moderátor kvůli poruše h: In the morning our host dropped out because of a voice problem, so Vlasta had to host the exhibition at Great-Grandpa's Tractor, contrary to plan. Every cloud has a silver lining, and thanks to little Márty, whom he took along, the exhibition was ridden with 3 riders straight away. From Čáslav we went to Bratronice near Kladno, where Martin Šimůnek with Vlasta and Petr Jeřicha – who almost didn't make it because his car broke down – ran a workshop and an exhibition. The Kabeláč sisters helped too, joining in the riding.
Do Bratronic nakonec dorazila i Čáslavsk: In the end the Čáslav squad also arrived in Bratronice, the riders were reshuffled, and Lukáš Valný, Vlasta, the girls and Tobík Dolák set off for a children's day in Choteč. Martin Šimůnek and Matouš, on the other hand, went to Suchdol for the local sports festival. Petr Jeřicha took his car to be serviced, and meanwhile in Moravia Mára Tryner and Michal Budský were warming up at Slavex bike park before the exhibition in Bojkovice.
Krásné počasí a super návštěvnost na vše: Beautiful weather and great turnouts at all events were refreshing and motivating for us. Cyklistikou žiji už od mládí, kdy jsem k: I've lived for cycling since I was young – my parents led me to it, or rather, bikes were never missing in our family and accompanied me throughout my childhood, whether it was a folding bike, a BMX, an MTB or a road bike. I got into cycle trial at 14, when I saw someone jumping on a bike over benches for the first time in my life. It was Michal Budský on a 20” bike. All at a time when I was racing MTB for Cykloprag Praha. Since then I've been hooked on cycle trial, and Michal Budský became my teacher.< I started on my old 26” Scott Vail MTB, which took a real beating during my first steps in trial. Suspension fork, chainrings, derailleur – basically everything went to pieces. In the end I bought an old, cracked 20” trial bike for about CZK 6,000, and since then I've gone through about 4 more bikes. In the following years, while studying at the Faculty of Civil Engineering in Brno, I switched to 26” bikes and gradually started riding cycle trial under the UCI, or rather the Czech Cycling Federation. In 2008 I founded my own online shop for trial components, which still operates today and which I keep trying to move forward. It also allows me to test new components, and I try to pass my experience on to customers so that everything suits them as well as possible. I don't sell….I help. In 2015 I joined the Czech national team, i.e. the national cycle trial squad, and took part in the European Championships in Italy and France. A great experience! In 2016 I managed to beat my trial teacher in the Czech Championship. There was no rivalry between us, but I was honestly glad that he had passed his experience on to me so well that I could use it even against him. I'll never forget that. Thank you! What next? It's time to pass my experience on in turn…..
